3967-7084-8293.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Cleveland Booker triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

5540-8195-8290.manaNeeded: {4}{R}{R}{R} plus either {2} or 5 life and commander tax if applicable
5540-8195-8290.easyPrerequisites: An opponent controls two targetable creatures.
5540-8195-8290.description:
Cast Venser by paying {4}{R}{R} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Venser enters, it triggers targeting any applicable target, and Confusion of the Ranks also triggers targeting a creature an opponent controls.
Resolve the Confusion of the Ranks trigger, exchanging control of Venser and the targeted creature.
Holding priority, cast Redirect Lightning by paying {R} plus either {2} or 5 life, changing the target of Venser's trigger to Venser.
Resolve Venser's ability, creating two token copies of it with haste.
Put all but one Venser token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Venser tokens' abilities each trigger, with one trigger targeting the nontoken Venser and the other ability targeting any valid target.
Resolve the Venser ability not targeting Venser, creating two copies of the chosen permanent with haste.
Resolve the other Venser ability, creating two token copies of Venser with haste.
Repeat from step 6.
5540-8195-8290.notes: Additional results can be provided by the permanent you decide to copy in step 8, including landfall triggers and artifact ETB.

When the creature dies, Ashes of the Abhorrent and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Defiant Salvager's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

4279-4699-7316--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-4699-7316--216.description:

When the creature dies, Overgrowth Elemental, Rat King and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Rat King ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Overgrowth Elemental triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

requires.n: Activated or triggered abillity that untaps at least five lands

2821-6657--199.manaNeeded: {2} plus enough mana to activate or trigger the untap ability
2821-6657--199.easyPrerequisites:
You control additional lands that tap to add at least {2}{U}.
Gogo does not have summoning sickness.
2821-6657--199.description:
Activate or trigger the ability that will untap at least five lands you control.
In response, activate Gogo by paying {2} and tapping them, copying that ability once.
Resolve that ability, untapping Minamo, any land that produces {U}, and at least three other lands.
Activate Minamo's last ability by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Gogo.
Activate your remaining untapped lands, adding at least three mana.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times.
Once you have infinite mana, you can activate Gogo any number of times on any valid abilities for any value of X, also allowing you to infinitely untap any number of legendary permanents with Minamo.

Repeat each turn.

1987-2187-3110.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-2187-3110.description:

When Possessed Skaab enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.

907-1558-2557-2638-4231.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary.

Gain any amount of life.

Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {R}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.

250-779-1479-2907-4693.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Scute Swarm and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Overgrown Estate ability
Resolve the Scute Swarm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Scute Swarm triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

969-4153-6575--136.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, copying another nonlegendary Saga you control and putting two to three lore counters on it.
The Saga tokens first through fourth chapter abilities trigger, as applicable. Resolve all triggers, and sacrifice the Saga token upon resolving the final trigger.
When the Saga token leaves the battlefield, Resourceful Defense triggers, moving the lore counters from the Saga token onto Esper Terra.
Esper Terra's second, third and fourth chapter abilities trigger.
Resolve the second and third chapter abilities.
Resolve the fourth chapter ability, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G} and then exiling Esper Terra and returning it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
Resourceful Defense and Terra, Magical Adept trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, moving all counters from Esper Terra onto any other permanent
Resolve the Terra, Magical Adept trigger, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
969-4153-6575--136.notes: The chosen Saga must have no more than four chapter abilities. Once you have infinite white mana, you can instead copy any other permanent besides the chosen Saga, and move counters to and from Esper Terra using Resourceful Defense's ability.

560-2034-5320.notes: If you sacrifice a creature to start using Ashnod's Altar, the starting cost is reduced to {1}. You can instead use a permanent that can sacrifice itself (like a Treasure token) or another method to sacrifice a permanent (like Braids, Arisen Nightmare).
